figures.finding: Under the Personal Status Code a person without discernment through youth cannot exercise civil rights, and one who reaches discernment before majority lacks full legal capacity; a person lacking capacity acts through a statutory, testamentary or dative guardian (arts. 163, 164, 176).
figures.applies: Mauritania; the Personal Status Code (Law No. 2001-052) as the State quotes it.

sources.said: A person who reaches the age of discernment before reaching the age of majority does not enjoy full legal capacity

figures.finding: Mauritania's 2017 report gave sixteen as the minimum age of employment and eighteen for hazardous work (and marriage), while the Labour Code of 2004 (art. 153, which layer 3 read) says fourteen; the conflict isn't resolved here.

sources.said: 16 — minimum age of employment; (iii) 18 — minimum age for hazardous work
